params.message:
Drop the two AI SDK packages nothing uses

The agent loop on the Vercel AI SDK in models.mjs was never called: getAIProvider had no
caller, and generateText was imported and not used. Its two packages, ai and
@ai-sdk/openai-compatible, go with it, and fourteen packages they brought along leave the
lockfile. No other package changes.

Portal: Twee ongebruikte pakketten zijn uit de pipeline van Gentells gehaald.
